TASK_BLURB: Context: this repository belongs to our machine learning team. It is the evaluation harness for the binary text classifier that screens incoming messages before they reach our deployed assistant. The team uses it to measure how well candidate classifiers catch positives and to tune the alert threshold, and the numbers feed into the quarterly review for the next scheduled update.
DOMAIN_LINE: This package evaluates classifiers that flag positive texts in a stream of messages.
